entry.content:
Leica and Formula 1 launch their partnership with a Leica Q3 43 dressed for the paddock. A new Formula 1 look, available only in the Leica FOTOS app on this camera, adds higher contrast and richer saturation as you shoot, previewed in the viewfinder. The wireless-charging handgrip has a genuine carbon fiber shell, a material Leica doesn't traditionally use, made and tested only in Germany, and the soft-release button has a carbon inlay with a red rim. The non-slip black Microvelour covering is textured like a racing steering wheel, and the red accents echo its color-coded controls. A rope strap bearing both brands' logos and a Formula 1 carrying strap are included.

With only 106 miles on it, this F50 is now up for auction.

Inside is a fido-focused kit including gauze, antiseptic wipes, forceps, zip ties, wrap, and other essentials that can help keep your pooch stable until you can get him/her to the vet.

entry.content:
Whether you're discovering tequila for the first time or looking to deepen your appreciation for Mexico's iconic spirit, Tequila: A Tasting Course offers an engaging guide from field to glass. Spirits expert Millie Milliken explores tequila's rich history, the role of agave cultivation and jimadores, regional styles, production methods, and the characteristics that distinguish blanco, reposado, añejo, and beyond. The book also walks readers through tasting techniques, essential cocktail skills, and classic recipes, making it an approachable resource for anyone eager to explore the world of tequila with greater confidence.
